chatgpt.name: ChatGPT
chatgpt.notes: Business/API data is covered by separate Business Terms + DPA (openai.com/policies hub lists them) but no single canonical DPA URL surfaced in search; not fabricating one.

claude.name: Claude
claude.notes: Consumer terms confirmed via direct fetch. Commercial Terms/DPA differ from consumer; used the consumer-facing set since ChatGPT-equivalent product here is the consumer app. privacy_policy originally pointed at the privacy.claude.com portal root, which is a nav/index page with no real prose (639 chars of menu text, confirmed empty extraction even after the HTML-cleaning fix) -- swapped to the direct 'Is my data used for model training?' article, which answers the exact fact the pipeline extracts.

gemini.name: Gemini
gemini.notes: Gemini Apps Privacy Notice supplements the general Google Privacy Policy rather than standing alone; used the Gemini Apps Privacy Hub as the most specific public page.

microsoft-copilot.name: Microsoft Copilot
microsoft-copilot.notes: Consumer Copilot (for individuals) product line, distinct from Microsoft 365 Copilot enterprise product which has its own terms.

github-copilot.name: GitHub Copilot
github-copilot.notes: Free/Pro/Pro+ vs Business/Enterprise have different data-use terms (Business/Enterprise excluded from AI-training data use per GitHub's own changelog) — worth surfacing to admin reviewer since one product covers two different data postures.

windsurf.name: Windsurf
windsurf.notes: Rebranded from Codeium; search only turned up a combined terms-of-service page (privacy content embedded in it), no standalone privacy-policy URL — not fabricating one. CORRECTION (2026-08-17): earlier note said 'acquired by OpenAI' — wrong. Confirmed live: windsurf.com/terms-of-service-individual now 308-redirects permanently to devin.ai/windsurf/terms-of-service-individual, i.e. Windsurf was acquired by Cognition (maker of Devin), not OpenAI. See DECISIONS_NEEDED.md for why this domain still can't be fetched.

sourcegraph-cody.name: Sourcegraph Cody
sourcegraph-cody.notes: Confirmed still active as of June 2026 privacy policy update; Cody is now bundled under Sourcegraph's broader "AI Tools" umbrella rather than a standalone product name.

adobe-firefly.name: Adobe Firefly
adobe-firefly.notes: No Firefly-specific privacy policy URL exists separately — Firefly is covered by Adobe's general Privacy Policy plus a dedicated 'data and content usage' explainer page, used here as the closest thing to a security/trust page.

grammarly.name: Grammarly
grammarly.notes: Individual-account privacy policy explicitly does not cover Business/Education/Pro-under-org accounts, which fall under a separate DPA — same two-tier pattern as GitHub Copilot.

jasper.name: Jasper
jasper.notes: DPA exists but must be separately executed by customers per Jasper's own terms; no public standalone DPA URL found.

notion-ai.name: Notion AI
notion-ai.notes: Used the AI-specific security/privacy practices page as the closest thing to AI-scoped terms; general Notion ToS covers the rest of the product.

zoom-ai-companion.name: Zoom AI Companion
zoom-ai-companion.notes: Zoom's general Terms of Service page used since no AI Companion-specific ToS URL surfaced separately from the privacy/security explainer.
